title: RF Assessment Knowledge Object (v2 — RF-ASSESS Batch 1)
$comment: NON-EXECUTABLE structural schema for draft Rectus Femoris assessment metadata. Unknown top-level fields are disallowed (additionalProperties:false). An assessment object describes HOW evidence about a capacity is gathered (observed/asked), contributing qualitatively to capacity evidence. It carries NO score, NO threshold, NO pass/fail decision, NO timeline, NO dosage, NO prescription, and NO diagnosis / autonomous-triage / progression / readiness / RTT / RTS / clearance authority. capacities_measured_or_informed references existing universal CAP-### objects only (never RF-CAP or demand-profile objects). Objects must remain draft/pending, clinically not approved, non-executable, runtime-disconnected, and metadata-only.

assessment_id.description: Stable unique identifier for an RF assessment object. Empty string is permitted only in the blank template.

assessment_purpose_category.description: Single category from the shared assessment-purpose taxonomy.

capacities_measured_or_informed.description: Universal CAP-### capacities this assessment contributes evidence to. References only; never a clearance decision. May be empty for safety/diagnosis-context screens.

evidence_contribution.description: Qualitative description of which capacity evidence this can raise. Never a score, threshold, or pass/fail.

allowed_when.description: Inert metadata context only. Never a runtime-selection trigger.
